golfTip.title: Hot tip
golfTip.body: Buy a Golfamore card (€59 per person) before you play. It gives you half the green fee once a year at each partner course, including San Roque New Course.
golfTip.example: Example: with a €72 green fee at San Roque New Course you save €36. Play one more Golfamore course at a similar price and you've saved about €72, more than the card cost. Green fees vary by season, so check current prices.
golfTip.warning: The half price covers the green fee only. A buggy is charged at full price on top, so the card is best value when you walk the course.
golfTip.autumnOffer: Timing tip: around the start of September each year, Golfamore usually runs an offer where buying next year's card also gives you the rest of the current year. That's a full year plus about 4 months for the price of one.

gettingHere.title: Getting here
gettingHere.intro: Casa Hoyo 8 is about 110 km west of Málaga Airport (AGP), just before Sotogrande. Here's how to get from the airport to the villa, from easiest to cheapest.
gettingHere.pricesNote: Prices checked in October 2026. They change, so please confirm before you travel.

car.title: Rental car
car.lead: The easiest option. Pick the car up at Málaga Airport and you can drive straight to the villa.
car.a7Time: About 1 h 30 min, more in traffic through Marbella
car.mix: A middle option: take the free A-7 to Estepona, then the AP-7 only for the last stretch, Estepona–Guadiaro (€2.45 Oct–May, €4.05 Jun–Sep). The full toll splits into Málaga–Estepona €9.55 / €15.50 plus Estepona–Guadiaro €2.45 / €4.05.
tips: Pay at the toll booths with a card or cash.
Choose a full-to-full fuel policy, so you only pay for the fuel you use.
Most rental companies put a deposit on a credit card, so check the limit before you go.

bus.title: Bus (Avanza)
bus.lead: Avanza runs direct buses from Málaga Airport to Estepona bus station several times a day. The ride takes about 1 h 10 min.
bus.fees: Booking online adds a €2.50 web fee and €1.75 travel insurance per person.
bus.lastLeg: The bus stops in Estepona, not at the villa. From Estepona bus station a taxi takes about 25–30 minutes.

taxi.title: Taxi or private transfer
taxi.lead: Door to door with no planning. Good value when 3–4 people share it.
tips: Taxi: there's a rank outside arrivals. The metered fare is roughly €140–170, higher at night, at weekends and on public holidays.
Private transfer: booked in advance at a fixed price, from about €120 for up to 4 people. The driver meets you in arrivals.

apps.title: Uber, Bolt & Cabify
apps.lead: All three work at Málaga Airport. Compare the apps, because prices change with demand.
tips: There are few app drivers around San Roque and Sotogrande, so for trips from the villa, book ahead or call a local taxi.
Don't rely on an app for an early-morning ride to the airport. Book a taxi or transfer the day before.
